facts.fact: The Full-News article says firms can check name availability, file statutes, pay fees and receive registration documents online through the CFE site cfetogo.tg, in under four hours, with online payment since 2019.

facts.fact: The article says business registration, including payment of administrative fees, can be completed online through the CFE portal cfetogo.tg, launched under economic reforms.

facts.fact: CFE director Samuel Sanwogou says firms have been able to pay registration fees through Flooz and Tmoney online payment means since February 2019.

The article says administrative fees for company registration are paid online via the CFE site, by Flooz, Tmoney, Mastercard or Visa, and cites electronic payment of public services as part of the digital strategy.
